reason: I'd throw the free 30 receipts at it, sure, it costs me nothing. But I'm not paying until it catches something my own checking misses, and a new Telegram bot from nobody I know could be gone by next year.
objection: The money I lose is cash to mechanics with handwritten notes. A bot can spot the same receipt sent twice, but it can't tell me a padded number on a scrap of paper is fake. And I don't know who's behind it or whether it'll still be running in a year.
would_change_my_mind: If during the free 30 it flags a real duplicate or a bad total from my scooter repairs that I missed myself, I'd pay the $19.
